description: This Java source file defines the class MockLegacySirenRepeaterCluster, which extends MockLegacySecurityCluster and implements Tamperable and BatteryBackedUp capabilities. It manages siren repeater device behavior, including handling manufacturer commands, reporting status, and managing tamper and power/battery states.

classes.name: MockLegacySirenRepeaterCluster
classes.description: Represents a mock implementation of a legacy siren repeater device, handling status, tamper, power, and command processing.

classes.name: SirenMode
classes.description: Enumeration of siren modes with associated tone values.

methods.name: handleMfgCommand
methods.description: Processes manufacturer commands such as siren mode, state, and LED settings, and logs the actions.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status byte array indicating tamper, power, and battery states.

methods.name: isTampered
methods.description: Checks if the device has been tampered.

methods.name: setTampered
methods.description: Sets the tampered state and sends a status update if changed.

methods.name: isACPowerLost
methods.description: Checks if AC power is lost.

methods.name: setACPowerLost
methods.description: Updates AC power loss state and sends a status update if changed.

methods.name: isBatteryBad
methods.description: Checks if the battery is bad.

methods.name: setBatteryBad
methods.description: Updates battery health status and sends a status update if changed.

methods.name: isBatteryMissing
methods.description: Indicates battery missing detection (not supported, always false).

methods.name: setBatteryMissing
methods.description: Logs a warning if attempting to set battery missing (not supported).
